servers.name: postgres-readonly
servers._notes: Three layers enforce read-only: (1) the MCP server wraps every query in `BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY` + `ROLLBACK`, so write statements fail at the transaction boundary; (2) `permissions/policy.json` pins every write-capable action to the destructive tier so the agent must confirm before even attempting a write; (3) the recommended setup uses a Postgres role whose grants are read-only, so even a server bypass cannot mutate data. Note: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres` does NOT accept a `--read-only` CLI flag and reads the connection string from its first positional argument, not from a `DATABASE_URL` env var.
